cross_section.position: side_k = sign(rel_z_k) on the BTC leg and -side_k on the ETH leg (long the relatively-cheap-term underlying, short the relatively-rich-term underlying); exposure_k = min(|rel_z_k|, size_cap)
cross_section.combination: ret_rel_k = ret_BTC_k + ret_ETH_k (equal-notional sum of the two spot-normalized EVAL-62 mark-path leg returns)

protocol.traded_form: two-leg cross-sectional relative-value ATM straddle spread (each leg: front expiry, common strike nearest spot, IV backed out of the real mark via EVAL-57 helpers) with the EVAL-62 mark-path net-of-cost P&L per leg: delta-hedge + half real 2-leg spread + hedge fee, spot-normalized, then summed
protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (basis signal x bar grid) has net-of-cost mean_return > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05 (H1: mean > 0), block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 on the mean, nonzero positions > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
